name: blueprint/cdp-debug
description: Debug a Node process over CDP without a PTY: start --inspect in the background, curl the CDP HTTP endpoints, capture, kill the job
ingredients: rh_run curl the CDP HTTP endpoints (list, eval)
recipe: start the process with --inspect in the background -> curl the /json list to find the target -> drive the debugger over CDP HTTP -> capture findings, kill the job
pitfalls: background jobs report status only - the CDP port is the interface (live-verified)
kill the job after - a stray inspector holds the port
the session receipts record what was captured
